requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_type = passenger_ship, THEN every person on board shall have one properly sized immersion suit OR one thermal protective aid.

requirement.sourceText: For passenger ships, a proper sized immersion suit or a thermal protective aid shall be provided for each person on board.
